create_APCalculator: create an APCalculator instance with dataset config and IoU thresholds to evaluate 3D detection average precision
run_parse_predictions: run parse_predictions to parse predicted 3D boxes with NMS and confidence thresholding from model outputs
run_AP_calculator_step: run the APCalculator step method to accumulate one batch of predicted and ground truth 3D boxes
run_compute_metrics: run compute_metrics on the APCalculator to compute mAP and AR across all accumulated predictions and ground truths
create_ap_config_dict: create an AP config dict with get_ap_config_dict to set NMS, confidence threshold, and empty box removal options
